items.title: Feist Inducted Into Canadian Songwriters Hall Of Fame, Gets Covered By Jeff Tweedy, Finneas, & Charlotte Cornfield
items.summary: Last night, Leslie Feist, who has built a fantastic legacy as part of Broken Social Scene and with her solo music as Feist, was inducted into the Canadian Songwriters Hall Of Fame at Massey Hall in Toronto, ON, Canada. The night also honoured '80s rock band the Tragically Hip, Mike Reno and Paul Dean of rock band Loverboy, and pop singer-songwriter Roch Voisine. The post Feist Inducted Into Canadian Songwriters Hall Of Fame, Gets Covered By Jeff Tweedy, Finneas, & Charlotte Cornfield appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: KATSEYE Perform On SNL Season Premiere, Appear In Dream Academy Parody
items.summary: Last night, Sept. 26, was the 52nd season premiere of SNL . King of New York Jalen Brunson hosted and KATSEYE was the musical guest, performing their songs "Hootie Frutti" and "Animal." For the cold open, Ramy Youssef returned as Zohran Mamdani. The rest of the Knicks starting five (Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, and Josh Hart) also appeared in Brunson's monologue. The post KATSEYE Perform On SNL Season Premiere, Appear In Dream Academy Parody appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Chuck Varga, GWAR’s Sexecutioner, Dead At 68
items.summary: GWAR founding member Chuck Vargo, known as Sexecutioner, has passed away. Varga was battling cancer; the band set up a blood donation campaign in April and then launched a fundraiser in June to help Varga and his wife Bambi pay for medical bills. His death was announced on Sept. 25 by GWAR bassist Casey Orr aka Beefcake The Mighty. Varga was 68. The post Chuck Varga, GWAR’s Sexecutioner, Dead At 68 appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Massive Attack’s Robert Del Naja Arrested Again For Protesting Palestine Action Ban
items.summary: On Saturday, September 26, Massive Attack frontman Robert Del Naja was arrested under the UK Terrorism Act in Liverpool, outside the venue where the Labour Party conference is due to be held with new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, after protesting in support of Palestine Action.
